summary.title: How Far Does Corruption Robustness Transfer? A Leave-One-Family-Out Study on CIFAR-100-C.

definitions.per_corruption: arithmetic mean of five severity accuracies
definitions.per_family: arithmetic mean over all member corruptions and five severities
definitions.overall: macro mean over 75 corruption/severity conditions (15 types; no clean)
definitions.equal_family: separate macro mean over four family means; noise has 3 types, others 4
definitions.drop_pp: clean accuracy minus corrupted accuracy, percentage points
definitions.transfer_pp: held-out LOFO accuracy minus clean-baseline accuracy on identical conditions
definitions.mean_corruption_error_pct: 100 minus overall corrupted accuracy; no reference normalization
definitions.bootstrap: paired percentile interval; resample 10,000 original test-image identities with replacement, sharing each draw across models, corruptions and severities; conditional on seed 42
